cards.text: One Sabbath, Jesus is passing through the grainfields with His disciples, and as they walk along, the disciples start picking heads of grain. Grain, friend. The stuff that becomes FLOUR. I'm getting misty over here.

cards.question: The disciples are picking grain as they walk through the fields on the Sabbath. Who speaks up about it?
The Pharisees, a strict Jewish religious group (Acts 26:5), see the disciples picking grain. Their complaint is that it's unlawful to do on the Sabbath.

cards.text: Jesus answers with a question about David, who later became Israel's king (2 Samuel 5:3): "Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?"

cards.question: Jesus says that during the high priesthood of Abiathar, a hungry David entered the house of God. What did David eat there?
The consecrated bread David ate in the house of God was lawful only for the priests.

cards.text: And David didn't keep that bread to himself. He gave some to his companions as well, which is more than I can say for me with a fresh batch on the cooling rack.

cards.question: After the story about David, Jesus declares who the Sabbath was made for. What does He say?

answers.text: The Sabbath was made for man
The Sabbath was made for kings
The Sabbath was made for priests

cards.question: After saying the Sabbath was made for man, Jesus adds that man was made for the Sabbath too.
Son of Man is the name Jesus uses for Himself (Mark 2:10). He says that because the Sabbath was made for man, the Son of Man is ___ even of the Sabbath.

cards.text: Once again Jesus goes into the synagogue, and a man with a withered hand is there.

cards.question: A man with a withered hand is in the synagogue, and some people there are watching Jesus. What are they watching for?

answers.text: If He will heal on the Sabbath
If He will read from the scroll
If He will teach the crowd

cards.question: The people watching to see if Jesus will heal the man with the withered hand are watching in order to accuse Him.

cards.text: So they're watching in order to accuse Him, and Jesus says to the man with the withered hand, "Stand up among us." Right in the middle of everybody, which, for a stamper who spent years in the back of a junk drawer, sounds TERRIFYING.

cards.question: With the man standing among them, Jesus asks which is lawful on the Sabbath. What is the first pair of choices He gives?

answers.text: To do good or to do evil

cards.question: Jesus asks the people watching Him whether it's lawful on the Sabbath to do good or evil, to save life or destroy it. How do they answer?

cards.text: They are silent, so quiet you could hear a sprinkle drop. Jesus looks around at them with anger and sorrow at their hardness of heart.

cards.question: Jesus says to the man, "Stretch out your hand." The man stretches it out, and his hand is ___.
After Jesus restores the man's hand, the Pharisees go out. Who do they start plotting with?
The Pharisees and the Herodians begin plotting how they might ___ Jesus.
